title: 突破超大尺寸三维编织核心技术，助力大飞机碳纤维部件研发
titleEn: Breakthrough in Ultra-large 3D Braiding Core Technology, Advancing Large Aircraft Carbon Fiber Component R&D
summary: 云路复材技术团队在超大尺寸三维编织工艺方面取得了革命性进展，完成了外径达1.5米的三维环形碳纤维管材的连续编织。此技术的突破将有力支撑国产大飞机机身肋梁及特种大承力构件的轻量化自研。
summaryEn: Yunlu Composites' technical team achieved revolutionary progress in ultra-large 3D braiding processes, completing continuous braiding of 3D annular carbon fiber tubes with an outer diameter of 1.5 meters. This breakthrough will strongly support the lightweight independent R&D of domestic large aircraft fuselage ribs and specialty heavy load-bearing components.
content:
云路复材技术团队在超大尺寸三维编织工艺方面取得了革命性进展，完成了外径达1.5米的三维环形碳纤维管材的连续编织。此技术的突破将有力支撑国产大飞机机身肋梁及特种大承力构件的轻量化自研。

目前国际上超大直径碳纤维三维纺织设备多处于对华禁运和技术封锁阶段。云路复材技术人员历时近两年，自主研发了重载自适应放线架以及高精度的同步进给补偿滑道，成功解决了大角度倾斜织造时断纱率高、张力波动大的核心痛点。目前首批样件已经通过了静态压缩和弯曲应力测试，力学表现达到国际一线同类构件水准。该技术的突破代表着我国在大型航空复材构件数字化织造领域迈出了重要一步。
contentEn:
Yunlu Composites' technical team achieved revolutionary progress in ultra-large 3D braiding processes, completing continuous braiding of 3D annular carbon fiber tubes with an outer diameter of 1.5 meters. This breakthrough will strongly support the lightweight independent R&D of domestic large aircraft fuselage ribs and specialty heavy load-bearing components.

Currently, international ultra-large diameter carbon fiber 3D textile equipment is largely under embargo and technology blockade against China. Over nearly two years, Yunlu Composites' engineers independently developed heavy-duty adaptive creels and high-precision synchronous feed compensation slides, successfully solving the core pain points of high yarn breakage rates and large tension fluctuations during steep-angle braiding. The first batch of samples has passed static compression and bending stress tests, with mechanical performance reaching international first-tier component standards. This breakthrough represents an important step for China in the digital braiding of large aviation composite components.
